company.name: Clipme
company.shortDescription: Clipme app lets candidates create 20 second video clips about themselves to pitch to employers.
company.description: Clipme is a mobile application that enables fresh graduates searching for jobs to pitch themselves through a 30 seconds video clip. Clipme thus gives job seekers a voice and a chance to be heard and to express a free flow of their experiences and skills. It also allows employers to choose the best fit and required personality traits that match their needs. clipme is targeting Startups & SME's to cut their candidate hunt time in half and connect to all candidates that spark their interest with a simple double-tap on their clips.
